ChangeStatus.description:
Status of a change delta (SPEC-0001 R5); `draft` is its initial status.

- `draft`: Proposed, not approved.
- `approved`: Approved by a person; its tasks may start.
- `implementing`: Its tasks are under way.
- `done`: Merged into its living specification and archived; terminal.
- `superseded`: Replaced by the change deltas in `superseded_by`; terminal.

Operation.description: An operation of a change delta on one requirement of its living specification.

name.description: The name of the requirement; required for `renamed`, optional for `added` and `modified`.

requirement.description: The existing requirement, `R<k>`; required for `modified`, `removed` and `renamed`. An added requirement gets its identifier when the delta is merged.

text.description: The text of the requirement; required for `added` and `modified`.

OperationKind.description:
What an operation of a change delta does to a requirement (ADR 0014, SPEC-0009 R2).

- `added`: Adds a requirement, which gets its identifier when the delta is merged.
- `modified`: Changes the text of a requirement, and its name when one is given.
- `removed`: Removes a requirement, which stays recorded with the status `removed`.
- `renamed`: Changes the name of a requirement only.

description: A change delta (SPEC-0001, Change delta): a reviewable change of the requirements of a living specification (ADR 0014, SPEC-0009 R2).

design.description: How the change is made, when the proposal does not say it.

id.description: Stable identifier, in the canonical form of the type; assigned by the engine and never reused (SPEC-0001 R2, R14).

issue.description: Tracker issue that requested the change.

language.description: Language of the prose, a BCP 47 tag; when absent, the language of the project.

operations.description: The operations, at most one per requirement; at least one.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema of the type the document was written against (SPEC-0001 R16).

specification.description: The living specification the delta changes.

status.description: Current status (SPEC-0001 R5), not the issue-cycle state of SPEC-0002.

superseded_by.description: Identifiers of the artifacts of the same type that replace this one, at least one; required when `status` is `superseded`.

items.description: Identifier of a change delta: `CHANGE-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `CHANGE-0012`.

tasks.description: Tasks that implement the change; `[]` means none.

items.description: Identifier of a task: `TASK-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `TASK-0107`.

title.description: Outcome or name, in sentence case without a final full stop; 1 to 120 characters (Unicode code points).

title: Change
